title: The European Union
text: The European Union (EU) is a supranational political and economic union of 27 member states located primarily in Europe. It was established by the Maastricht Treaty in 1993, building on earlier economic integration through the European Economic Community (EEC) founded in 1957 by the Treaty of Rome. The EU has developed an internal single market with free movement of goods, services, capital, and people. The euro, introduced in 1999, is the common currency of 20 EU member states. The EU institutions include the European Parliament, the European Commission, and the European Council. The United Kingdom withdrew from the EU on January 31, 2020, in a process known as Brexit.
